trello.name: Build frontend checkout form with Stripe Elements
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within two weeks for initial integration. Implement the checkout process using Stripe Elements, ensuring the form matches the app's design (clean, straightforward, prominent checkout button). Handle potential errors gracefully, such as invalid card details or insufficient funds. Include a tooltip or help icon explaining what happens if the user chooses a different plan later.

trello.name: Update pricing page with subscription tiers
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within two weeks for initial integration. Update the pricing page to reflect the three subscription tiers: Basic ($29/month with basic AI model selection tool and limited features), Pro ($49/month with additional features and priority support), and Enterprise ($99/month with all features, custom support, and integration options). Provide a clear comparison of features for each tier.

trello.name: Build user dashboard for subscription management
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within two weeks for initial integration. Build a user dashboard that includes: current plan details and billing info; options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscription; access to invoices and payment history; a way to update payment methods. The dashboard should be intuitive, reflect current subscription status in real-time, and notify users of changes such as successful plan upgrades or payment failures.

trello.name: Integrate frontend with backend API
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: after Taylor completes backend setup, within the two-week initial integration window. Integrate the frontend components with the backend API. Ensure any changes to the subscription are reflected in real-time on the dashboard. Handle errors during integration and provide clear notifications to users (e.g., clear instructions if a payment fails).

trello.name: Implement user notifications for subscription events
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within two weeks for initial integration. Implement user-facing notifications for various subscription events, including subscription confirmations and payment errors. Notifications should clearly inform users and provide instructions on how to fix issues when applicable.

trello.name: Create help section/FAQ for subscription management
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan (with team support). Deadline: once everything is live. Create a help section or FAQ that covers common issues and questions about subscriptions, including clear instructions for users on how to manage their subscriptions, access invoices, and handle any issues.

trello.name: Integrate Stripe API for subscription management on backend
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: within two weeks for initial integration. Integrate Stripe's API to handle all subscription-related tasks, including creating and managing subscriptions and processing payments (handling both successful and failed payments). Ensure the backend activates or continues a user's subscription upon successful payment.

trello.name: Set up and test webhook handlers for Stripe events
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: within two weeks for initial integration, with thorough testing during the one-week testing phase. Set up webhook handlers for the following events: invoice.payment_succeeded (confirm successful payments and activate/continue subscription), invoice.payment_failed (notify users of failed payments, prompt them to update payment info, and consider sending an email notification), and customer.subscription.deleted (manage cancellations, update access rights, and possibly offer re-subscription). Create test scenarios to simulate different events like payment failures and cancellations, and test the handlers thoroughly to ensure they update the system correctly.

trello.name: Prepare detailed test plan for subscription flow
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: share with team ahead of the one-week testing phase. Prepare a detailed test plan covering both manual and automated tests. The plan should cover the whole subscription flow from sign-up to billing to managing the subscription, including all edge cases. Share the plan with Alex and Jordan.

trello.name: Document API endpoints and webhook event handlers
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: ongoing, for future maintainability. Document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers to make it easier to maintain and troubleshoot the integration in the future.

trello.name: Schedule follow-up meeting for next week
trello.desc: Owner: Alex. Deadline: next week. Set up a follow-up meeting to review progress on the Stripe subscription integration and address any issues or blockers that come up.
